name: Alene
title: Circle of the Stars Druid
role: The party's spell save DC caster and only healer: control spells under a Starry Form, radiant debuffs on the side.

shape.name: Level-10 swapper
shape.summary: Dragon form until level 10 to keep concentration on control spells. From level 10, switch forms for free once per turn: Archer for a radiant bonus-action arrow, Chalice when healing, back to Dragon when holding something big.
strong: Concentration almost never breaks in Dragon form.
Strongest Stars Druid from level 10, when every form is one free swap away.
Covers the party's healing without giving up control.
weak: Leaving Dragon form gives up its concentration floor.

choices.label: Ability scores
options: DEX 14 · CON 16 · WIS 17 (+ STR 8, INT 8, CHA 10): safest concentration
DEX 16 · CON 14 · WIS 16: more AC and initiative
choices.note: Either way, Wisdom goes up first with feats.

choices.label: Race
options: Gnome: Advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves
Half-Elf or Wood Elf: darkvision and extra speed
choices.note: Druid already has medium armour and shields, so armour from race adds nothing.

choices.label: Armour
options: Medium armour and a shield: about 17–19 AC
A spell-DC robe or light armour: less AC, more DC

tips: Vesper's theft plan counts on your Guidance when she's about to cast Friends.
Produce Flame makes you a light source, which the Act 2 Coruscation Ring needs.

prepare.note: You prepare Druid level + WIS modifier spells and can swap them outside combat.

levels.gains: Spellcasting from the whole Druid list.

tips: Take Dragon form before fights: a bonus action and a Wild Shape charge, lasting until a long rest. You have 2 charges, back on a short rest.
Use Dazzling Breath as your bonus action every turn.
levels.gains: Wild Shape, Starry Form and the Star Map's free Guiding Bolts.

prepare.note: Spike Growth and Hold Person are the control picks; Pass Without Trace sets up the Ranger's surprise rounds.

choices.label: Feat
options: Alert: go first and can't be surprised
War Caster: Advantage on concentration saves
Resilient: +1 CON and CON save proficiency

tips: War Caster matters least for this shape: Dragon form already covers concentration until level 10.
levels.gains: Feat, third cantrip, more Wild Shape forms.

prepare.note: Plant Growth needs no concentration: quarter speed, no save. Pair it with Spike Growth.

tips: Cosmic Omen is a reaction 3 times a day. Woe subtracts 1d6 from an enemy's save after the roll; save it for your big control spell.
levels.gains: Cosmic Omen (Weal or Woe, decided each long rest).

prepare.note: The Dryad lasts until a long rest and casts her own Spike Growth and Entangle, keeping your concentration free.

choices.label: Feat
options: Ability Improvement: +2 WIS, or +1 WIS and +1 CON
War Caster: worth it now if you'll leave Dragon form from level 10
Resilient: +1 CON and CON save proficiency

levels.gains: Feat and more Wild Shape forms.
5th-level spells; Cosmic Omen uses rise to 4.

tips: Switch Starry Form once per turn for free: Archer for Luminous Arrow on a quiet turn, Chalice when you heal, Dragon whenever you're holding concentration.
Leaving Dragon form gives up its concentration floor. Swap back before the enemy's turn if your spell matters.
levels.gains: Twinkling Constellations: forms improve to 2d8, Dragon can fly, and you can swap forms for free once per turn.

prepare.note: Cast Heroes' Feast with a staff's free spell before big fights; it buffs the whole party.

loadouts.label: Act 1
loadouts.intro: Good picks per slot. Mix to taste: Spell DC, Radiant debuffs, or Concentration to hold your spells.

loadouts.label: Act 2
loadouts.intro: The radiant debuff kit comes together here, alongside the first +1 DC pieces.

loadouts.label: Act 3
loadouts.intro: The spell DC capstones arrive. Stacking the DC pieces reaches about DC 25.

turn: Before level 10: be in Dragon form. Action for a control spell, bonus action for Dazzling Breath.
From level 10: swap form once per turn for free. Archer's Luminous Arrow or Chalice's extra heal, then back to Dragon if you're holding concentration.
Save Cosmic Omen (Woe) for the save that decides the fight.
Spend Star Map charges on Guiding Bolt: the next attack on that target has Advantage, which helps Pearl and Zetharis.
start_of_day: Prepare control, one heal and one utility spell; swap freely outside combat.
From level 7, summon the Dryad: she lasts until a long rest and holds her own Spike Growth.
From level 11, cast Heroes' Feast with a staff's free spell before a big fight.
tips: Plant Growth plus Spike Growth: quarter speed and damage per step, and only Spike Growth needs concentration.
In any Starry Form you can't use some reactions, such as Absorb Elements.
The radiant kit (Luminous Armour or Gloves, Coruscation, Callous Glow) stacks Radiating Orb: −1 to the target's attack rolls per turn, up to −10.
Give Vesper Guidance before her pickpocketing: she can't hold Friends and Guidance herself.
